newsitem.title: MEXICO: Abaco, Principal Int'l to form pension fund firm.
newsitem.headline: Abaco, Principal Int'l to form pension fund firm.

text.p: Mexico's Abaco Grupo Financiero said Monday it had signed a letter of intent with Principal International, a subsidiary of Principal Financial Group of the U.S., to form a pension fund firm, or Afore.
Abaco said in a news release the partnership would "complement the services offered by Abaco in the areas of health insurance and life insurance."

"This agreement outlines the minority participation of The Principal International Inc in Abaco and forms part of the its capitalization plan to reach specialized niche markets," Abaco said in a news release.

The U.S.-based Principal Financial Group also has its Principal International subsidiaries in Spain, Argentina, Indonesia, China and Honk Kong. Last year it began operations in Chile and acquired a pension fund firm in Argentina, Abaco said.
